name: Guam Code Annotated (the laws of Guam, as compiled by the Office of the Compiler of Laws)
label: Guam
record_note: The Compiler of Laws publishes only the current text of each chapter of the Guam Code Annotated and keeps no earlier versions, so each chapter has one version here: the text as compiled on the day stamped on its pages. The index says "Updated through P.L. 38-143 (Oct. 13, 2026)". There is no line-by-line history before that. The SOURCE notes naming each public law are kept as text and listed in data/amendments.csv.

dates.commit: the date the Compiler stamped on the chapter's pages ("COL 2026-05-29"); the retrieval day where a chapter has no stamp
dates.time: 12:00 UTC+10 (Chamorro Standard Time, no daylight saving time)

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Guam; effective-date and savings provisions are in the public laws and, where the Compiler kept them, in the NOTE lines under each section

default_reach.meaning: no part of the Guam Code is retroactive unless expressly so declared
default_reach.authority: 1 GCA § 702 ("No part of this Code is retroactive, unless expressly so declared.")

reuse: Statute text is not copyrightable: under the government edicts doctrine (Georgia v. Public.Resource.Org, Inc., 590 U.S. 255 (2020)) nobody owns works made by legislators or judges in their official capacity. 1 GCA § 1607 lets the government of Guam copyright the Compiler's work product and keep the form and structure of the laws public. Private repository; see SOURCES.md.

citation.note: files are <title folder>/<chapter folder>/<section>.md; section numbers are unique within a title (1 GCA § 1607 is title-01/chapter-016/1607.md). The Rules of Evidence are rule-<n>.md.
